{{Quote|Slovenly? If I had the troops they do in the north&hellip;"<br />"If you were the sort of leader they have in the north&hellip;|High General Touno and [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]|<ref name="Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand 1">[[Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand 1|''Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand'' 1]]</ref>}}
[[High General]] '''Touno''' was the commander of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] garrison in the southern district of [[Svivren/Legends|Svivren]] as of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. A portly [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] with brown eyes and thinning brown hair, he was a reflection of the sparse and badly-disciplined troops he had under his command. One of his staff officers was [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Strok (Galactic Empire)|Strok]], who was actually working for the organized crime group [[Black Nebula (organization)|Black Nebula]]
